title: ray-mcp-server 0.2.1 shipped malicious code (Hades/Shai-Hulud PyPI campaign)
summary: PyPI package ray-mcp-server version 0.2.1 contained malicious code delivered through a setup.pth payload, part of the Hades campaign hitting PyPI packages. Published as PYSEC-2026-1074 / OSV MAL-2026-5325. Only 0.2.1 is listed as affected; installations pinned to other versions should still verify their environment, and machines that installed 0.2.1 (e.g. via `uvx ray-mcp-server`) should rotate secrets.
